chapter: Clubs, publishers, unions and life in Denver
title: Plan to trace his changing piano harmony and chord use
summary: The interviewer asks Horace to think about when ninths, elevenths, thirteenths and altered tones entered his playing; Horace says he'll have to practice piano again.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment
